description: Returns the College Board score distribution (percent of students scoring 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 and 3 or higher) for an AP exam and year, plus student counts, mean and standard deviation where College Board published them (2024 and 2025 PDFs). Includes the May 2026 results from the College Board 2026 AP Score Distributions page, which are newer than most model training data. Shows the 2024/2025/2026 history for the exam.

exam.description: AP exam name or common short name, e.g. "AP Biology", "APUSH", "Calc BC", "Lang", "Physics 1", "APES".

year.description: Exam year (May administration). Available: 2024, 2025, 2026. Default 2026, the latest College Board release.

name: get_ap_score_distribution
title: Get the official AP score distribution for an exam
